title: GIVING TUESDAY - Chamber Gives Back - Convoy of Hope
seo_title: Giving Tuesday Volunteering at Convoy of Hope
description: This Giving Tuesday volunteer event, called Hands of Hope, has volunteers count, sort, box and bag product at Convoy of Hope headquarters, with tasks varying by need and groups sometimes split up. Youth ages 10-12 may join with a parent or guardian and signed consent, and ages 13-17 need signed parental consent; children under 10 are not eligible. It runs Tuesday, December 1, 2026, from 6:30 PM to 8:30 PM at the Convoy of Hope World Distribution Center, One Convoy Drive, Springfield, MO, and volunteers need closed-toe shoes and a current liability waiver on file.
venue: Convoy of Hope World Distribution Center
